name: 锤头鹳
description: 三三两两地站在建筑的高处，有些神秘，被认为是王国的守护者。洛克靠近时，会发出尖锐刺耳的声音，头部奇怪的形状为工具设计提供了设计灵感。
descriptionEn: Standing in twos and threes atop buildings, somewhat mysterious, believed to be guardians of the kingdom. When a Roco approaches, it emits a sharp, piercing cry, and the strange shape of its head inspired tool design.

skills.name: 鸣叫
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 羽翼庇护
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：自己获得连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; when responding to attacks: gains combo +2.

skills.name: 风矢
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 潮涌
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; if acting before the enemy, becomes 3-hit combo.

skills.name: 乘胜追击
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，每次使用后，本技能连击数永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; each use permanently increases this skill's combo +1.

skills.name: 盐水浴
skills.description: 自己获得全技能能耗-2，应对防御：改为技能能耗-3。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains all-skill energy cost -2; when responding to defense: becomes -3.

skills.name: 水炮
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次使用后，本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; each use permanently reduces this skill's energy cost -1.
